item.title: 2001 Hummer H1 Open Top
item.description: This 2001 Hummer open-top pickup is a four-door example that is powered by a 6.5-liter turbodiesel V8 mated to a four-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case, and it is finished in Bright White over two-tone gray upholstery. Features include halogen headlights, a trailer towing system, a removable black soft top, halogen headlights, a Central Tire Inflation System (CTIS), heated front seats, high-back bucket seats, air conditioning, a Monsoon sound system, and an AM/FM/casset

item.title: Michelin Tire Giveaway, Round 10—Pick Your Favorite!
item.description: As the holidays approach, we’re up to Round 10 of the 2025 Michelin/BFGoodrich Tire Giveaway. Every month, our generous partners at Michelin USA grant us the ability to give away a brand new set of Michelin, Michelin Classic, or BFGoodrich tires. In turn, we ask you, the BaT community, to help us choose one special vehicle drive off with fresh treads.

item.title: 14k-Mile 2006 Chrysler PT Cruiser Hatchback Limited Edition at No Reserve
item.description: This 2006 Chrysler PT Cruiser Limited Edition hatchback has been registered in Washington since new and was acquired by the seller in 2025. Power is provided by a 2.4-liter inline-four paired with a four-speed automatic transaxle, and it is finished in Inferno Red Crystal Pearl Coat over Pastel Pebble Beige cloth. Equipment includes the Chrome Accent Group, a sunroof, fog lights, a rear spoiler, front disc brakes, 16" aluminum chrome-clad wheels, cruise control, a CD stereo, and air conditioning

item.title: 2014 Maserati Ghibli S Q4 at No Reserve
item.description: This 2014 Maserati Ghibli S Q4 remained registered with the initial owner in Georgia until 2025, and it is finished in Bianco over Cuoio leather upholstery. Power is provided by a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 linked with an eight-speed automatic transmission and an all-wheel-drive system. item.title: Supercharged LS1—Powered 2006 Pontiac Solstice 5-Speed
item.description: This 2006 Pontiac Solstice was acquired new by the seller and modified by Trax Customs of Meridan, Idaho. Power comes from a 5.7-liter LS1 V8 equipped with a Magnuson supercharger and linked to a five-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential, and the car wears a custom vinyl wrap. It rides on 19" Avant Garde wheels along with an adjustable air strut suspension system and is further equipped with a fiberglass hardtop, revised front and rear fascias, a fiberglass hood, Ksport USA

item.title: 1950 Ford Custom Deluxe Tudor Sedan 3-Speed
item.description: This 1950 Ford Custom Deluxe Tudor sedan was refurbished in 2005 and acquired by the seller in 2022, reportedly from the original owner. It is finished in maroon with a silver roof over gray cloth upholstery and powered by a 239ci V8 linked to a column-shifted three-speed manual transmission. Equipment includes a dual exhaust system, a hood ornament, and a split windshield with a visor as well as body-color steel wheels, chrome hubcaps, rear wheel skirts, bodyside moldings, and twin side mirrors

item.title: Original-Owner 2019 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport Coupe 2LT 7-Speed
item.description: This 2019 Chevrolet Corvette Grand Sport coupe was initially delivered to Cox Chevrolet of Bradenton, Florida, and it was purchased new by the seller. Indicating 19k miles, the car is powered by a 6.2-liter LT1 V8 linked with a seven-speed manual gearbox and an electronic limited-slip differential. item.title: 2007 Ferrari F430 Spider
item.description: This 2007 Ferrari F430 Spider is powered by a 4.3-liter DOHC V8 paired with a six-speed F1 automated transaxle and is finished in Rosso Corsa over beige leather upholstery. item.title: 1963 Porsche 356B Coupe
item.description: This 1963 Porsche 356B coupe was fitted with four-wheel disc brakes under prior ownership and refurbished in the mid-1990s. It has been repainted in Champagne Yellow over beige leatherette and is powered by a replacement flat-four paired with a four-speed manual transaxle. Features include dual Weber carburetors, 15" steel wheels, body-color bumpers, twin engine grilles, front bucket seats, a cabin heater, and an analog clock. item.title: Bobby Rahal’s 1967 Toyota 2000GT
item.description: This 1967 Toyota 2000GT is one of 351 examples built during a three-year production run and is said to have originally been sold in Mozambique. Chassis 10128 reportedly went on to be acquired by a South African collector in the late 1970s and made a brief stop in the US in 1986 before being purchased by a Costa Rican Toyota importer, with whom it spent the following 28 years. A refurbishment was performed by Restauraciones Clásicas in Costa Rica between 2013 and 2014 before the car was purchased
